x2_operational_negatives.summary: The first phase-local skill initialization stopped when the inherited console codec could not encode Māori text after five packages completed; no package received completion credit until UTF-8 was pinned and all twenty passed unchanged validation.

The first integrated runtime stopped when Windows rejected disposable SQLite fixture teardown because context-manager exit had not closed a backup handle; the failed run received zero integrated credit and explicit closure recovered the unchanged tribunal.

The first scoped evidence validation reported one lexical scanner candidate as a confirmed private callable and one scoped-test error while its compact receipt omitted the diagnostic traceback; the failed validation received zero evidence-pass credit.

The first exact evidence staged review rejected nine frozen family-current runner filenames because its scope predicate recognized only version-prefixed scripts; no x1-frozen path changed and the failed review received zero commit-gate credit.

The first staged fixed-point check exposed one semantic browser-diversity field inside the runtime as an unresolved callable candidate and showed that receipt-writing console status had not propagated privacy or JSON failure state; the commit remained blocked.

After the staged-scanner incident was recorded, the broader evidence validator correctly found the documented accessibility token inside the Method Flow record and ledger as two callable-pattern candidates; the failed validation received zero pass credit.

The first closeout builder stripped leading whitespace from Git porcelain output, truncated the first allowed owner path, and stopped before writing lifecycle artifacts; the successful 30-task portfolio step remained bounded evidence.
